release-bot: Deploy window open for embeddings-svc v0.9.1. Feature-flag plan: `emb.v0.gated-unwind` 0% -> 4% -> 25% over 45m. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Paging @elaine @ben.

elaine: ack. I'll watch p50/p95, embedding cosine drift, and cost-per-token. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/releases/embeddings/v0.9.1

ben: request auto-pin rules: if 5xx >1.8% for 4m OR p95 +300ms -> auto-pin to v0.9.0. Also prefer 1% first step.

anya: +1 on 1% starter. Suggest disable the large-quant shard until after 10% to reduce mem pressure.

deploy-bot: Plan updated and scheduled toggles. Steps: 1) set flag to 1% 2) hold 10m, check metrics 3) advance to 4% then 25%. Auto-pin target v0.9.0.

ben: running initial toggle in 2m:
```
/redwood flag set --name emb.v0.gated-unwind --pct 1 --who ben --note "start gentle"
```

ops-bot: preflight passed: infra healthy, gpu headroom 30%, db lag 0.2s. Alerts armed to page @ben on sustained error-rate.

elaine: metrics at 1% after 8m: p95 baseline 120ms -> 130ms, 5xx steady 0.3%. holding.

deploy-bot: advancing to 4% now as scheduled.

elaine: at 00:12 saw p95 jump +320ms and 5xx to 2.1% for ~3m. traces show cache write race. paging @ben.

ben: manual pin executed to stop ramp:
```
/release pin --service embeddings-svc --version v0.9.0 --who ben --reason "elevated errors during ramp"
```

deploy-bot: Manual pin recorded at 8555557879 by ben. Rolling back cohorts to v0.9.0 and draining v0.9.1. Posted to #release-notes: "v0.9.1 ramp halted; pinned to v0.9.0 pending infra investigation."

anya: opening bug with traces and sample inputs; assigning infra-cache.

elaine: agree hold on reattempt until cache fix + 24h staging soak. updating release ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
